entries.cause: The bounded integrated V3 packet omitted the 2,371-row candidate payload, so V4 could not compare nine M6 concepts across providers.
entries.next_discriminator: Use the recovered bounded nine-row identity packet for future source-frame dedup; never treat an omitted payload as zero overlap again.
entries.observed: The original handoff still held the candidate JSONL under the recorded SHA-256; 9/9 exact reported M6 rows were recovered (Earth 2, Software 6, Physical 1), and all nine concept/publication pairs are unique. No V3/V5 publication, version DOI or concept DOI overlap was observed.
entries.residual: Recovery licenses only exact identity deduplication; V3 author-lineage and natural-pair status remain CANNOT_CHECK.

entries.cause: An exact JOSS archive DOI does not automatically state a repository tag or commit. Only archive metadata with an explicit GitHub tree/release/commit URL was accepted.
entries.next_discriminator: For the same failed DOI identities only, pre-freeze a source-native archive provenance or Software Heritage origin/revision route; add no replacement papers.
entries.observed: 103/200 had one archive-explicit tag/commit identity matching the JOSS repository; among the 80 V4 provider-qualified rows, 48 did.
entries.residual: Rows without an explicit archive-to-tag/commit relation remain CANNOT_CHECK; matching version strings or dates were not substituted.

entries.cause: Two archive-explicit tag candidates returned GitHub ref HTTP 404; one lies inside the V4-qualified frame.
entries.next_discriminator: Resolve the same tag identity through source-native release metadata or an immutable Software Heritage revision, preserving the HTTP-404 evidence.
entries.observed: 101/103 selected identities resolved to 40-hex commits; 47/48 selected V4-qualified identities resolved.
entries.residual: A named but unresolved tag is not an immutable version relation and contributes zero bridge candidates.

entries.cause: Some DOI registrations omit, self-reference or ambiguously encode the distinct concept DOI for the archived version.
entries.next_discriminator: Query only the same archive identity at its source-native version endpoint under a new freeze; do not infer concept identity from DOI prefix or filename.
entries.observed: 165/200 expose exactly one distinct DOI IsVersionOf relation; 68/80 V4-qualified rows pass this gate.
entries.residual: A labelled archive DOI without a distinct version-to-concept relation remains insufficient for cross-version concept control.

entries.cause: Generic copyright, missing rights, nonaccepted licences and NOASSERTION are not hand-mapped to accepted software rights.
entries.next_discriminator: For failed identities, bind exact source-native version rights plus immutable-commit rights; do not infer from the default branch or repository description.
entries.observed: 179/200 have at least one accepted DOI-registered SPDX licence; 83/101 resolved commits have an accepted SPDX licence after syntax-only canonicalization. All 39 exact bridge passes satisfy both gates.
entries.residual: Failed rights rows contribute zero exact bridge candidates; one exact candidate has no Zenodo-native licence field but has matching exact DataCite BSD-3-Clause registration and commit licence.

entries.cause: Nine V4 JOSS relation failures and later repository changes cannot be converted into new V4 units by re-reading mutable pages.
entries.next_discriminator: Repair only under same-identity frozen provenance routes; never replace a failed DOI with a new page or count a changed repository as continuity.
entries.observed: V5 retains all 200 DOI identities but requires the V4 provider-qualified predecessor and unchanged V4 repository/domain identity; exactly 39/80 pass the complete bridge and no V4-failed identity is promoted.
entries.residual: 41 V4-qualified rows remain exact-version bridge failures; the other 120 remain under their original V4 failures.

entries.cause: Exact version bridging reduces the V4 80 provider-qualified concepts to 39, while V3 contributes only nine predecessor-strict Figshare metadata concepts.
entries.next_discriminator: After same-identity bridge repair, freeze non-GitHub domain-specific publication-linked release providers; Software still needs at least two additional disjoint-provider concepts even if its V4 bridge expands.
entries.observed: Deduplicated V3-strict plus V5-exact public-source candidate totals are Earth 5/48, Life 4/48, Software 36/48 and Physical 3/48. V3 disjoint replication counts are 2/8, 0/8, 6/8 and 1/8.
entries.residual: No M6 domain passes total, primary and source-disjoint replication gates; surplus in Software or another cell cannot compensate.

entries.cause: Different repositories/archive hosts establish a transport-source distinction, not independent authors, independent scientific claims or independent statistical units.
entries.next_discriminator: Freeze an outcome-blind external lineage and natural-pair adjudication packet before any case label or system outcome.
entries.observed: All 39 exact bridges use JOSS+GitHub+Zenodo and are structurally provider-family disjoint from the nine V3 Figshare identities; externally adjudicated author-lineage independence remains 0.
entries.residual: Provider-family disjointness cannot license lineage independence, same-claim preservation or natural-pair eligibility.

entries.cause: Public metadata does not adjudicate same target claim, one-coordinate information-state change, material resolvability or outcome protection.
entries.next_discriminator: Commission the frozen outcome-blind external panel only after the source cells pass identity, relation, rights, dedup, lineage and quota gates.
entries.observed: 0 author-lineage decisions, 0 natural-pair adjudications and 0 eligible natural pairs.
entries.residual: All 39 exact bridges remain transport candidates only. P4_NATURAL_PAIR_SOURCE_TRANSPORT_CANNOT_CHECK is preserved.

entries.cause: The first Zenodo wave hit HTTP 429 for 46 identities and HTTP 410 for one.
entries.next_discriminator: Preserve the 410 and use only an immutable source-native tombstone or Software Heritage identity for that same DOI under a new freeze.
entries.observed: A same-identity sequential resume recovered all 46 rate-limited records; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20816805 remains HTTP 410. Original failures are retained, and no DOI was added or replaced.
entries.residual: The one withdrawn/gone source-native archive remains CANNOT_CHECK and is not among the 39 exact bridge passes.
